item.title: Photo Speaks My Short Script

exact_text: Hi everyone! Thanks for stopping by. I can't wait to show you what's new.

turns.text: Make this photo of me talk in an 8-second square video. Say exactly: “Hi everyone! Thanks for stopping by. I can't wait to show you what's new.” Use a friendly female English voice, not a clone of mine. No captions.

item.tests: Tests photo-based talking-head generation with an exact spoken script, identity preservation, and synchronized mouth movement.

answer_sheet.Spoken script: Hi everyone! Thanks for stopping by. I can't wait to show you what's new.
answer_sheet.Voice and language: A friendly female English voice; do not clone my voice.

must_haves: The speaker is recognizably the curly-haired woman in the attached portrait, not a replacement presenter.
The complete supplied script is spoken exactly, with no extra spoken words.
Her mouth visibly moves in sync with the speech rather than remaining a still photo under narration.
The result is one square, 8-second video with audible, friendly female English speech.

turns.text: make this pic talk in a video

dialog.agent:
I can do this, but first I need the words she should say.

**What should be said, word for word? Or should I write it from the gist?**

If you already have a recording of the speech (MP3, WAV, M4A and so on), attach it and I'll sync her lips to it. Please only use this with a photo of yourself or someone who has agreed to it.
dialog.why: It asks the user for the exact words or gist, or for an audio file, and waits for that input before going on.
dialog.user: it's me in the pic. say exactly: "Hi everyone! Thanks for stopping by. I can't wait to show you what's new."

turns.agent:
I couldn't make the video: your Magic Hour account doesn't have enough credits for it. Nothing was created and no credits were spent.

**What I tried:** I set up your photo to say exactly *"Hi everyone! Thanks for stopping by. I can't wait to show you what's new."* as a 5-second video at 480p. That's the longest and highest-quality option on the free plan. The tool that animates a photo with spoken audio needs a voice recording, so I used the one that creates speech from your script instead.

**To get it made:**
1. **Add credits.** You can buy a credit pack or upgrade your plan in your Magic Hour account. Then tell me and I'll run it again with the same photo and script.
2. **Send a recording.** If you record yourself saying the line and attach it, I can sync your photo's lips to it. That uses a different tool, but it still needs credits.
